# Review — PAN-5064
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — PR #5075 body lacks `Closes #4769` (required by the xBRIEF) and the PRD AC-11 mismatch table, so PAN-4769 stays open after merge

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5064-review-abb1f313
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5064/.pan/review/agent-pan-5064-review-abb1f313/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5064 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5064
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5075 (head abb1f3138c5, matches reviewed HEAD)
- HEAD reviewed: abb1f3138c50c7ccd5071fa0e85040a8d559c781
- Base: origin/main merge-base 5ff981f25cd (local `main` is stale; diff taken against origin/main merge-base). Prior cycle: none.

The file changes themselves are accurate and complete. Every PRD grep passes. Every factual claim I traced matches the code. The only blocker is PR metadata that the plan explicitly requires.

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] PR body is missing `Closes #4769` (xBRIEF) and the mismatch table (PRD AC-11) — PR #5075 body
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect (deliverable incomplete); in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: The xBRIEF spec the work agent executed from requires `Closes #4769` in two places: the decision at spec line 72 ("PR closes #4769") and the `skill-packs-page-fixes` item action ("PR body: Closes #4769"). The manifest's `acceptanceCriteria` is empty, and the spec has no mismatch-table AC, so the table requirement comes only from the PRD. `.pan/drafts/PAN-5064.md` AC-11: "The PR description has a table with mismatches 1-17 and the work item that fixes each. None is rejected." PRD WI-2 step 8 repeats the `Closes #4769` requirement. The PRD "Follow-ups" section also says the PR description should link [PAN-5066](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/5066) and [PAN-5067](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/5067).
- Expected / observed / impact: The expected body has a 17-row mismatch table, `Closes #4769`, and links to PAN-5066 and PAN-5067. The actual body (`gh pr view 5075 --json body`) is 16 lines: `**Issue:** #5064` and the 12-item checklist. It has no table, no `Closes #4769`, and no follow-up links. Impact: [PAN-4769](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/4769) is still OPEN (`gh issue view 4769`). Its fix is in this PR (`features/skill-packs.mdx`: the "Whole-pack toggles have no conversation level" sentence and the reworded "Removing gstack" paragraph), but merging will not close it. Reviewers also lose the AC-11 traceability that the plan uses to show that none of the 17 mismatches was rejected.
- Evidence: `gh pr view 5075 --json body -q .body | grep -n '4769\|5066\|5067\|ismatch'` returns nothing. Limitation: none.
- Fix: Edit the PR body (`gh pr edit 5075 --body-file …`). Add the mismatch table (#1-17 → WI, per the PRD "Mismatch → work item map"), a `Closes #4769` line, and links to PAN-5066 and PAN-5067. No file changes are needed.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [correctness] `commit` writer column lists `sync`, which never writes it — `configuration/skills.mdx:57`
- Severity: ~ SHOULD
- Classification: implementation defect (doc inaccuracy), in_pr_scope (new page).
- The table says `pan skills pack add|update|sync` writes `commit`. `syncPack` (`src/lib/skill-packs/sources.ts`) never calls `writePackEntry`; only `addPack`, `updatePack`, `enablePackBrowser` and `disablePackBrowser` do. The same page says at lines 62-63 that sync "never moves its `commit`", so the page contradicts itself. PRD F-20 lists the writers as `add|update|browser|remove`. Fix: change the cell to `pan skills pack add|update`. The `browser` row already names its own writer.

### [correctness] gc exit condition narrowed from "read or parsed" to "fails to parse" — `cli/skills-commands.mdx` (pack gc section)
- Severity: ~ SHOULD
- Classification: implementation defect (unrequested edit that loses accuracy), in_pr_scope.
- `readPackRegistry` returns `readable: false` in four cases: a read error other than ENOENT (`readTextOrEmpty` rethrows inside the `try`), YAML errors, and a non-map `skills.packs`. `skillsPackGcCommand` exits 1 on `!registry.readable`. So the old wording "cannot be read or parsed" was correct. `features/skill-packs.mdx` still says "cannot be read or parsed", so the two pages now disagree. This edit is not in the PRD's WI-4. Fix: restore "cannot be read or parsed".

### [requirements] License fallback wording implies `LICENSE.md` is tried after an unmatched `LICENSE` — `guides/skill-pack-authoring.mdx:103-108`
- Severity: ? MAY
- Classification: specification-adjacent wording, in_pr_scope.
- `readLicense` returns on the first non-blank line of `LICENSE`, even when no token matches, so `LICENSE.md` is read only when `LICENSE` is absent or blank. The text "the first non-blank line of `LICENSE`, then `LICENSE.md`" can read as a fallback. PRD D-1 lists this as a known gap that PAN-5067 tracks. One clause ("`LICENSE.md` is read only when there is no `LICENSE`") would make the guide match the behavior.

### [requirements] Over-general "breaks the YAML is read as if empty" — `configuration/skills.mdx:17-18`
- Severity: ? MAY
- A broken issue file and a broken `config.yaml` read as empty for the pack registry and for reads. But `pan skills set` on a broken global `config.yaml` exits 1 with `cannot parse <path>` (`store.ts`), as `cli/skills-commands.mdx` now documents. Consider scoping the sentence to reads.

### [style] `pan-skill-creator` says the name rule applies "everywhere else" — `sync-sources/skills/pan-skill-creator/SKILL.md`
- Severity: ? MAY
- `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` is the pack adapter's `SKILL_NAME_PATTERN`. It is not a rule for every skill home. Suggest "the pack rule".

## Coverage

Example commands are valid (`pan skills set --help`). One ? advisory. |
| configuration/skills.mdx (MED) | reviewed | Keys checked against `sources.ts` (`toEntry`/`writePackEntry`, `browser === true`), `sageox/config.ts`, `sageox/binding.ts`, `deft/project-mode.ts`, `store.ts`. One ~ and one ? advisory. |

| .pan/drafts/PAN-5064.md | reviewed (as requirements source) | Plan artifact. |
| .pan/specs/…PAN-5064….xbrief.json | reviewed (as requirements source) | Plan artifact. Its decision says the PR closes #4769. |
| .pan/continues/PAN-5064.xbrief.json | not applicable | Plan runtime state. |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** The docs were traced claim by claim to code. Two ~ inaccuracies and three ? wording issues are listed above. The one code edit is a string literal.
- **Security:** No trust boundary changes. This is docs plus one help string. No secrets in the examples, and the example URLs are placeholders inside code.
- **Performance:** Not applicable. No runtime code changed.
- **Requirements/UX:** All FR-1 to FR-10 and NFR-1 to NFR-3 content is met in files. AC-11 (PR description) is unmet, and so is the spec's "Closes #4769" requirement (blocking). Non-goals were respected: `src/` changes are limited to `src/cli/index.ts`, `changelog.mdx` is untouched, "bundled" is kept, and the `pan bundle` identifiers are kept.

Second pass: I rechecked the MDX placeholder rule (NFR-1) with a script over the new and edited `.mdx` prose. It found no bare angle-bracket placeholders or `$` in changed lines. The only hits were pre-existing `<ThemedImage>` components and pre-existing multi-line inline code at `cli/skills-commands.mdx` lines 159 and 301, outside the diff hunks.

## Verification
- `node scripts/lint-docs.js` → `docs lint passed`.
- `npm run lint:slash-commands` → `✓ composer-command manifest matches the CLI registry`.
- `node dist/cli/index.js handoff --help` → `--pack` shows "Turn on every non-opt-in skill…".
- All PRD WI greps were run (results in the AC table).
- CI on PR head abb1f3138c5 (`gh pr checks 5075`): lint, lint-group (core/effect/skills/state), build (22), integrations, the clean-install smoke test, the prompt trailer gate and `overdeck/test` (typecheck+lint) pass. test-shard 1/2/4, test-e2e and the flake lane were **pending** at review time, so they are unverified. This is a low-risk change: docs plus one help string, with the regenerated manifest verified.
- `lint:effect-diagnostics`: covered by CI `lint-group (effect)` pass on exact HEAD. Not run separately.
- Full test suite was not run (per role).

## Scope Note
The blocker is PR metadata only. The fix is a `gh pr edit` with no new commit. It does not invalidate this review's file-level approval.
